milestones.title: Research and decision freeze
milestones.userValue: Retire risks that could force a rewrite of ingestion, execution, or hosting.
milestones.gate: Every P0 spike has a fixture-backed result and a documented fallback.

milestones.title: WSL-first bootstrap and static shell
milestones.userValue: A clean WSL checkout builds a bilingual static shell through one documented workflow.
milestones.gate: Doctor, checks, tests, and a static EN/RU build pass from a clean WSL checkout.

milestones.title: Deterministic ES2026 ingestion
milestones.userValue: The specification becomes navigable, provenance-rich structured data.
milestones.gate: Two extractions are byte-identical and all graph integrity fixtures pass.

milestones.title: Knowledge graph and bounded context
milestones.userValue: Readers and agents can navigate real dependencies without loading the whole specification.
milestones.gate: Cyclic graphs terminate, context packages explain inclusion, and output is deterministic.

milestones.title: Content model and publication workflow
milestones.userValue: Articles become reviewable evidence objects instead of unstructured prose.
milestones.gate: Broken citations locale drift stale hashes and uncertain ready claims stop publication.

milestones.title: English vertical slice
milestones.userValue: The first complete topic explains this from syntax through runtime semantics.
milestones.gate: Every claim has evidence and readers can trace obj.method() to the this binding.

milestones.title: Examples Test262 and three engines
milestones.userValue: Normative explanations are backed by reproducible observable evidence.
milestones.gate: V8 SpiderMonkey and JSC run slice fixtures with provenance and sandbox tests pass.

milestones.title: Russian MVP and public release
milestones.userValue: A reviewed bilingual module is publicly accessible as a static site.
milestones.gate: EN and RU parity accessibility licenses provenance and Pages deployment are green.

milestones.title: ESMeta enhancement
milestones.userValue: Readers can correlate JavaScript execution with formal traces without depending on ESMeta at runtime.
milestones.gate: Missing ESMeta artifacts degrade gracefully and present traces have provenance.

milestones.title: V8 implementation layer
milestones.userValue: Advanced readers see one pinned implementation without confusing it with the standard.
milestones.gate: Every V8 artifact is pinned and visibly implementation-specific.

milestones.title: Scale and v1
milestones.userValue: The project becomes a maintainable learning system rather than a one-off demonstration.
milestones.gate: Source updates produce a reviewed stale queue and new modules reuse the same pipeline.
